## What changes?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Separate simulated tests from hardware tests. For native changes, include the Windows/driver environment and any remaining compatibility limits.

## Review notes

- [ ] User-facing documentation matches the change.
- [ ] Relevant regression tests were updated, or this is a documentation-only change.
- [ ] New dependencies and license notices were reviewed, if applicable.
- [ ] The change contains no personal profiles, device identifiers, session notes, or build output.
